prompt: Write a short, polite reply declining a meeting on Friday at 3pm, and suggest next week instead.
response_text:
Here's a short, polite reply declining a meeting on Friday at 3pm and suggesting next week instead:

"Dear [Name],

Thank you for inviting me to meet on Friday at 3pm. Unfortunately, I won't be able to make it at that time. Would it be possible to schedule an alternative meeting for next week? I'd be happy to discuss some options with you.

Best regards,
[Your Name]"
